title: The Morning Circuit — Friday, June 05, 2026
description: Top stories: The token bill comes due: Inside the industry scramble to manage AI’s runaway costs; Not the next R8? Audi reveals mid-engined plug-in hybrid V8 Nuvolari.; NASA briefly sheltered space station astronauts in SpaceX’s Dragon due to leaks; The University of Cambridge says it successfully tested a vaccine with an AI-designed antigen; NSA said to be readying Anthropic’s Mythos for use in cyber operations.
